The '''Executioner's Warstaff''' was an [[Electrostaff/Legends|electrostaff]] used<ref name="Cartel Market" /> around the time of the [[Third Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR_updates">{{TOR_updates|5.10}}</ref> Executioner's Warstaffs were used by [[the Brothers]] on [[Mek-Sha]].<ref name="TOR:BK" />
